reasons: The cited fee construct (p0056-p0063, p0070) is genuinely usage-based: the Monthly Notional Volume bands set a declining rate per US$1m actually traded and operate as a volume discount, not a floor, so the preferred position (fees for usage only) is met.

The p0070 'in no event less than' sentence is a floor measured by volume actually recorded as traded multiplied by the applicable rate - it prevents underpayment of actual usage rather than imposing a minimum spend, so it is not a take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic.

No minimum, committed volume, shortfall or take-or-pay language appears in the document; the 36-month Initial Period is a licence term without a purchase obligation, and the fixed $2,500/month support fee is consideration for ordered maintenance services, correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment is proposed and none is required; the Licensor-side rebate commitment is properly left alone as it benefits us.
